commit.message:
Adjust spacing and use image_url for star photo

Increase vertical spacing for the star name tooltip on the index page (mt-2 -> mt-5) to improve layout. Fix star detail page to use row.image_url for the photo source (was row.photo_url).

commit.message:
Use single seededRandom for positioning

Remove the centerBiased helper and use a single seededRandom call for x and y (seed and seed+571).

Adjust sky effects, focus behavior, and star creation

Tidy up visuals and navigation: refine meteor animation (use rotate+translateY for consistent paths), adjust meteor counts per page (about:0, index:10, star:2), and lower star/nebula intensity on the star page. Improve star creation flow by capturing INSERT result and redirecting to the newly created star (use result.lastInsertRowid) and include row.timestamp in the seed so generated positions are unique. Pan/zoom and focus: import and expose focusStar, set initial panzoom startScale to 0.2, add URL ?focus handling, and simplify focusStar to perform non-animated zoom/pan and restore 'contain' immediately to avoid buggy long animations. Misc: reduce ambient audio volume and delay playback to 30s.
